items.title: 2.2.1.3 Creating Different Types of Variables (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of variable types (PDF 36).

blocks.text: Python mein alag alag types (qismon) ke variables banaye ja sakte hain ta ke har tarah ka data rakha ja sake. Kuch aam types yeh hain:

items: Integer (int): whole numbers (poore number, bina point ke). Misaal: age = 17
Floating-point (float): decimal numbers (point wale number). Misaal: price = 19.99
Boolean (bool): sirf True ya False. Misaal: is_student = True

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text:
• Variable ke naam mein lowercase (chhote) letters aur words ke beech underscore rakhna achhi aadat hai (maslan student_name). Is style ko snake_case kehte hain.
• Yaad rakhein: Python mein string hamesha quotes mein hoti hai, single (' ') ya double (" ").

blocks.prompt: Integer aur float data types ka farq misal ke saath bataiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: int whole number rakhta hai jis mein decimal point wala hissa nahi, jaise age = 17; float decimal number rakhta hai, jaise price = 19.99. / se division hamesha float deti hai (10 / 2 = 5.0).

blocks.text: type() batata hai ke variable mein kis type ka data hai. Maslan age ko 17.5 kar dein ya price ko quotes ke saath "19.99" likhein aur Run karein; type badal jayegi.

age = 17
price = 19.99
name = "Ali"
is_student = True
print(age, type(age))
print(price, type(price))
print(name, type(name))
print(is_student, type(is_student))
